Disjoint timed rows; sampled full-row validation runs after all four variants per layer.
Summaries include only layers where every variant physically reads at least 95 percent of requested bytes.
Buffers are touched before timing; model bank slots have a wider range of offsets.
Component latency does not establish model throughput or answer quality.
Each variant validates two of eight timed rows per layer, not every timed row.
Staged reads reuse one buffer; private reads use eight buffers. Small differences may reflect cache and TLB state.
Scatter and staged write different bank slots; their row alignment may differ.
Pairwise effects use layer means on the same common set; this is one component run.
